setup_choice.title: How do you want to set this up?

menu_options.configure: I already have an address and rolling code

configure.title: Enter your remote's details
configure.description: Enter the address and rolling code captured from an existing remote (e.g. via `decode_capture.py`).

pair_intro.title: Before you start
pair_intro.description:
This registers Home Assistant as a brand-new remote for this motor, and walks through setting its travel limits. No captured address or rolling code needed - we'll invent a new one from scratch.

**Right now:** long-press the reset/PROG button on the motor itself (or hold PROG on a remote already paired to it) until it jogs briefly. That puts it into pairing mode.

Once it's jogged, enter a name for this blind and continue.

pair_register.title: Registering with the motor
pair_register.description:
Sending the Up+Down signal now. The blind should briefly jog up and down as confirmation that it's registering this new remote.

Didn't jog? Make sure it's still in pairing mode (redo the long reset-button press if needed), then choose Retry.

pair_top.title: Set the TOP position
pair_top.description: Use Up/Down to jog the blind to the position you want as its fully-open (top) limit. Each press sends one command, so use it like a real remote's buttons. When it's where you want it, choose Confirm.

menu_options.pair_bottom: ✅ Confirm - this is my TOP position

pair_bottom_jog.title: Set the BOTTOM position
pair_bottom_jog.description: My+Down was just sent, so the blind should be moving down on its own. Use Down to keep it moving, Up if you overshoot, and choose Stop exactly when it reaches the position you want as its fully-closed (bottom) limit.

menu_options.pair_bottom_stop: 🛑 Stop - this is my BOTTOM position

pair_top_confirm.title: Confirming the TOP position
pair_top_confirm.description: Sending My+Up. The blind should run back up on its own to the top limit you set. Once it's reached the top and stopped, choose Continue. If nothing happened, choose Retry.

pair_long_my.title: Long-press My
pair_long_my.description: Sending a long My/Stop press (6 total frames) to save the limits you just set. The blind should briefly jog up and down as confirmation. If it didn't, choose Retry, otherwise Continue.

pair_prog.title: Finishing up
pair_prog.description: Sending Prog. This saves the setup and registers Home Assistant as an authorized remote for this motor. The blind should briefly jog up and down as confirmation. If it didn't, choose Retry, otherwise Continue to finish.

frame_repeats.name: Frame repeats
frame_repeats.description: Additional repeat frames within this one transmission (same rolling code). 0 = a single frame; raise to simulate a longer hold.
